purpose: The dashboard shows progress from local data only and never spends the owner's GitHub access.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-12 the owner directed: "take this as starting point and deliver till end. Delivery this work with the AIWorks environment." The starting point is docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md (PR #12), with owner decisions D1, D3, D5 (direction only) and D9 recorded in its section 8. This campaign fixes #16: the dashboard stops calling the GitHub API and reads the supervisor store and local git instead. The program merges PRs with merge commits, so a verified commit itself lands on main and local git can prove it merged. Commits are published as PRs only: the supervisor never merges or deploys, and the live runtime, its data directory, the governance checkout and the scheduled tasks are never touched. No run cap or cost ceiling (AW-002); provider limits are waited out. Provider order Claude, then Codex.

constraints: Program netbka/aiworks#14: deliver docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md through supervisor campaigns. Change only the files your task names. Other campaigns change other files at the same time: never edit their files, other agents' branches or worktrees, or campaigns/*.json.

Your assigned worktree is the only place you change files. Never touch D:/Git/aiworks/.local (live runtime, supervisor data directory, governance checkout, other worktrees) or the main checkout, and never start, stop or restart the supervisor, its scheduled tasks or the dashboard.

No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions changes, paid services, Telegram or other provider API calls, or new recurring spend. Never read .env contents, credentials or secret files. Read Engineering Platform only with read-only gh commands; never write the governance checkout or open changes in another repository: EP-side changes are proposed as text.
Follow AGENTS.md: run npm ci once in your worktree, then npm run check after changes. Report exact commands and pass/fail tallies.

Never weaken an assertion, delete or skip a test, or broaden a timeout to make the gate pass. Tests make no model, network or GitHub calls: synthetic executables and disposable git repositories, as tests/supervisor/helpers.mjs does.

Keep AW-001 to AW-007 as written. Do not enable a power whose decision is still open (GitHub-free local admission, Auto Release, Telegram delivery): design it, or build it switched off, and name the decision it waits for.

Label every claim about the running system observed, verified, planned or unknown (AGENTS.md evidence rule); merged is not deployed. Do not comment on GitHub, merge, close issues or change labels: the supervisor publishes your verified commit. Write "Refs #N", never "Closes".
Write for the owner first: plain English, short sentences, the outcome before the mechanism. Link Engineering Platform policies instead of copying them.

tasks.title: Dashboard shows progress from local data only, with no GitHub API calls
tasks.outcome: The dashboard never calls the GitHub API; every step, pull request link and merged state comes from the supervisor store and local git.
tasks.goal: Fix #16 (gh issue view 16). Remove every GitHub API call from the dashboard: the fetch in src/dashboard/roadmap.mjs, the refresh interval in main.mjs and /api/refresh in server.mjs. No gh, GraphQL or REST call remains. Build what owner.mjs and the views need from local sources: campaigns, tasks, published PR and report URLs and verified SHAs from the supervisor store; issue numbers and task titles from the stored declarations; the roadmap from the governance checkout files already read. Merged state comes from local git: a published commit is merged when its verified SHA is reachable from origin/<baseBranch> in the configured repository checkout (git merge-base --is-ancestor), refreshed by at most one git fetch of the base branch per configured repository every 5 minutes, one repository at a time (git protocol, not the API). Otherwise it reads "published, merge not seen yet", never merged. Drop merge readiness (CI checks, conflicts) and point to the pull request instead. Keep the rule that stale or unknown data never supports "ready to merge" or "merged". Stop using the GitHub snapshot in the dashboard cache. Update docs/OPERATIONS_DASHBOARD.md and the dashboard tests.
constraints: Change only src/dashboard/** except src/dashboard/supervisor.mjs (another campaign changes it), tests/dashboard/** and docs/OPERATIONS_DASHBOARD.md. Keep the security headers, origin and CSRF checks and the 127.0.0.1 binding (AW-003).
acceptance: No code path in src/dashboard runs gh or calls the GitHub API: a test with a synthetic gh that records every call shows zero calls across startup, refresh and every page and API route.

A step whose verified SHA is reachable from origin/<base> in a disposable repository shows merged; one that is not shows published, merge not seen yet; missing or stale data never shows merged or ready to merge (tested).
git fetch runs at most once per repository per 5 minutes, one repository at a time; a failed fetch keeps the last state and shows its age (tested).
npm run check passes; the PR lists what the dashboard no longer shows (CI checks, conflicts, issues not tied to a campaign) and states that nothing is deployed.
